crossRefs.note: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour…
“Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways…
The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?
translations.bsb: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Are My ways unjust, O house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
translations.kjv: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
translations.asv: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
